description: Accept M-Pesa payments on your WordPress shop through KioskPay. Ships a WooCommerce gateway and a [malipo_pay] shortcode.
changelog:
0.1.3

  • Self-updates from kioskpay.co.ke — new versions appear under Dashboard → Updates.

0.1.2

  • Rebranded to KioskPay across the whole admin.
  • Added the Client ID field and HTTP Basic authentication.
  • Corrected the API address to https://backend.kioskpay.co.ke.
  • New guided settings page with a Settings link on the Plugins row.
